description: 10th of 11, FinzData AI Trading Championship (Oct 2026), FinzData data only. Hypothesis (by Claude Sonnet): 12-1 momentum, earnings yield and ROE are weakly correlated premia; an equal-rank long-short monthly book limits beta and cost. Out-of-sample 2019-01 to 2026-09: Sharpe 0.28, CAGR 3.1%, max drawdown -28.7%; in-sample Sharpe -0.15. Caveat: the models' training data covers the test period. Forward-tracked from publication.
title: AI Trading Championship 10th (11 models): Claude Sonnet momentum-value-quality long-short
